disliked_text: This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result. The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers. The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation. To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises. I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway. Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem. Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment. It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.

В итоге я простоял на улице у двери в отель под дождем до практически 05:00PM, так как никто не отвечал на мои сообщения по почте, в букинге, в ватсап с 1:30PM! Ответили только ближе к 5 вечера, и пришлось ждать когда мне отправят коды от дверей! Причина в том, что якобы сотрудник не видел мои сообщения!!! liked_text: I had stayed at this property several times last year, and while the customer service wasn’t always outstanding, I understood it’s a hostel environment. However, during one stay, I was placed right next to a bathroom, and there was constant door slamming throughout the night (2–4am). Understandably, I was frustrated and contacted reception via the intercom. Unfortunately, I was told there were no options to move rooms and that I would just have to put up with it. The following morning, the manager informed me that I was no longer welcome, despite having stayed there for nearly two months the previous year and across multiple locations. I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted. I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion. I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times. Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless. Overall, the situation felt disproportionate and poorly handled. I was left confused, as the outcome didn’t seem to match the circumstances.

title: Muy buena ubicación y relación calidad-precio, con algunos detalles operativos
liked_text: La ubicación es excelente: está muy bien conectado y se puede llegar fácilmente desde el aeropuerto en metro, prácticamente sales de la estación y estás ahí. Las habitaciones son cómodas para ser un hostel, con buen ambiente y huéspedes respetuosos. Tiene buen WiFi, cocina equipada para guardar comida, varias duchas y baños disponibles, y servicios como lavandería que hacen la estancia práctica. En general, ofrece una muy buena relación calidad-precio considerando lo céntrico que es.
disliked_text: El acceso con equipaje puede ser incómodo, ya que hay escaleras y las habitaciones están en el segundo o tercer piso, y esto podría comunicarse mejor en el anuncio para que los huéspedes estén más preparados. Tampoco es muy práctico el servicio de storage gratuito que ofrecen: tuve que caminar hasta otra propiedad de la misma cadena, lo que implicó una subir la cuestas de Surry Hills y es una caminata de unos 30 minutos, pero es más rápido si se hace en Uber. El sistema de recepción es remoto (pantallas con atención desde fuera del país), lo que puede hacer el check-in más lento o confuso. Además, las puertas con código a veces fallan, lo cual puede ser incómodo. Finalmente, al estar en una zona con vida nocturna, puede haber algo de ruido los fines de semana, y la limpieza es correcta pero no impecable.

I couldn't take my shoes off in the room or I would soak my feet and socks. When I raised the issue with the accommodation, they did the bare minimum by putting a towel on the floor (half the room's carpet was wet) and leaving a bottle of disinfectant spray. No alternative room was arranged, and there was no initiative to offer compensation in any way. When I asked the issue to be escalated to management, they said it'd take 7-10 business days and when I waited 10 business days I had to follow up again because I hadn't heard anything. This place clearly thinks they can offer poor services and get away with it. I know they offer cheap rooms, so I was expecting something quite modest and minimal, but a room with a soaking wet floor is a whole new level of poor quality. Do NOT recommend.
